verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only installation: the Claude Code plugin marketplace commands and copying folders into `.claude/skills/`. Nothing describes listing installed skills, uninstalling them, or cleaning up the `replica/` folder and other artifacts the skills write. Any plugin listing or removal would come from the host Claude Code platform, not this product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list what is installed and remove skills cleanly, without orphaned files or lingering instructions
